assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Godot 2D top-down RPG AnimatedSprite2D action sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is an APPEARANCE REFERENCE only, do not reproduce its entire sheet. Use only the ROOKIE monster: small cute teal baby dragon, orange ear fins, single forehead golden horn, cream belly, large amber eyes. Match the reference's clean chibi painted sprite style, proportions and colors.
Generate a brand-new square transparent sprite sheet with EXACTLY 16 separate full-body poses, 4 equal rows x 4 equal columns. Only this ONE monster in all cells. No human, no other monsters. There must be wide transparent gutters around every pose. TRUE transparent alpha background.
Each ROW is a DIFFERENT facing direction in order: ROW 1 facing DOWN toward viewer, ROW 2 facing RIGHT pure profile, ROW 3 facing UP showing back, ROW 4 facing LEFT pure profile. Four animation frames across each row in chronological order.
MELEE BASIC ATTACK animation: column1 crouches and draws near claw back, column2 winds up with twisting torso and raised claw, column3 STRIKES with forceful extended claw/jaw forward in its facing direction, column4 retracts claw and recovers toward neutral. Make the contact pose dramatically different from idle, with clear full-body follow-through. Empty hands, do not add a weapon. Side-facing claws extend horizontally forward. Back-facing attack must actually show back and wings/tail, not front face. All four frames must visibly differ. Do not bake trails or flashes into this sheet.
Keep full creature including wings, horns, paws and tail inside each cell. Keep same physical scale between cells, feet near common bottom baseline, reserve padding for wide strike poses. Show real angular motion of arms, legs, jaws, body; do not just repeat/translate idle sprites. Preserve recognizable anatomy, no duplicated limbs, no cropping. No labels, text, grid lines, shadows or background.

targeted_edit.prompt: Edit this transparent 4x4 casting sprite sheet. Make ONE surgical correction: THIRD ROW, SECOND AND THIRD COLUMNS must be back views of the dragon facing AWAY/up, like third row first and fourth columns. Currently column2 wrongly shows cream belly/front. Replace those two poses with back-facing skill-charge and skill-release poses: orange neck fins and teal spiny back/tail visible, head raised away from viewer then pitched forward away from viewer, mouth aimed away/up with no visible front belly or eyes. Body must keep its orientation facing up in all four third-row cells. Keep all other 14 poses exactly unchanged, same scale/grid gutters, true transparent alpha. No effects/text, no extra sprites.
